tools.name: viridis_list_modules
tools.description: List ViridisOS modules and their LIVE/BLOCKED state (A-1 against the live canon).

tools.name: viridis_certify
tools.description:
Certify a subject (parcel/portfolio) with a module -> a certificate. Errors if the module's
backing theorem is not gate-passed (BLOCKED).

tools.name: viridis_certify_envelope
tools.description: Certify then return a 'Certified by ViridisOS' mark envelope (profile conservation-claim).

tools.name: viridis_verify_mark
tools.description: Verify a 'Certified by ViridisOS' envelope against the shared trust root.

tools.name: viridis_bind_did
tools.description: Derive the canonical did:viridis identity for an agent (fleet R1 formula) under the shared root.

tools.name: viridis_agent_attestation
tools.description: Issue a mark-stamped agent-attestation envelope under the shared trust root.

tools.name: viridis_compute_toll
tools.description: Compute the unified Viridis protocol margin (the take) + pass-through card cost for a settlement.
